findings.text: the boundary snapshot is now taken only when launch_kind == "cli", so an in-harness dispatch — the shipped default backend native, reckon/schema/flight-defaults.yaml:16 — writes neither repository_tree_snapshot on its pointer nor tree-snapshot.json in its run directory, which leaves promotion._repository_tree_boundary_violations returning [] at reckon/crew/promotion.py:1263-1264 and the stray-uncommitted-edit refusal at reckon/crew/promotion.py:1345 never firing for that lane; at base f3b75feb the same assignment was unconditional, so this silently removes a protection that was in force on the default dispatch path.

item_verdicts.diff: read the full diff f3b75feb..2468e1ca; the launch path is restructured so the snapshot moves into the supervisor, promotion learns to read the run directory's snapshot with a pointer fallback, and the four-case gate is added with no unrelated edit.
item_verdicts.done_when: read tests/test_dispatch_returns_without_worker.py and the four recorded gate runs; every clause of the four-case done-when is asserted against an independent fact — a measured dispatch return time, a real SIGKILL observed through an on-disk exit record, and a discarded pointer that stays discarded — not against the implementation's own report.
item_verdicts.goal: read reckon/crew/dispatch.py:4028-4069 against the node goal; the landed change does what the goal states — dispatch writes the pointer naming a detached per-run supervisor and returns, and the supervisor takes the boundary snapshot, spawns the worker and collects its exit.
item_verdicts.manifest: read the reviewed manifest and ran reckon crew check-manifest on the run; the audit returns ok: true at exit 0, and its claims match the logs, the two commits and the tree I read.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read both commits c8f0b545 and 2468e1ca against the six declared write paths; the diff touches exactly those six files and nothing else, and the plan's and the evidence anchor's existing content is preserved (96 added lines, 0 removed).

justifications.durability: tests/test_dispatch_returns_without_worker.py fails if dispatch waits for the snapshot, if the supervisor is not the worker's parent, or if no exit record is written, but no test fails when the in-harness lane loses its snapshot.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_dispatch_returns_without_worker.py records 4 passed in 150.07 s in the run's logs/gate.log with both declared controls failing as declared; the sole gap is that a gate log's first line names no revision, tree or command.
justifications.fit: the supervisor section at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:4740 follows the surrounding module's idiom and introduces no name the repository naming rules forbid.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch.py:4028 moves the boundary snapshot and the worker spawn behind the returning dispatch, which is the goal's own statement, though the same block also drops the snapshot for the in-harness lane the goal never mentions.
justifications.scope_discipline: every added path lies inside the declared write paths, but reckon/crew/dispatch.py:4036 narrows the boundary snapshot to cli launches, a behaviour change the goal does not imply and the plan section never names.
